Hello again night crew,
Staff rotas came up after lunch, so just a quick note

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and methodical through the evening handover. Our work remains to guide passengers with companion animal travel arrangements, confirm that each file is current, and pass along any concerns before the next team takes over. The senior coordinator will continue to make the daily service decisions, so if a situation feels uncertain, record it clearly and escalate it without delay. Clear notes, calm wording, and careful follow-through are especially important when a traveler needs reassurance or when a pet profile needs extra attention.

For routine contact, please review the open cases and keep messages consistent with the standard tone used at Aurelia Skyways. If a traveler sends updated travel details, make sure the record reflects the latest information before you move on to the next item. When you prepare replies, keep them concise, polite, and precise, and avoid any informal wording that could be misunderstood. If you receive a case involving special handling, bring it forward in the usual manner so the senior coordinator can review it. The aim is to keep the desk organized, supportive, and dependable throughout the shift.

Thank you for maintaining the usual standard of care and for helping the team close the day smoothly. Please leave the desk in good order, with all remarks entered and all pending items flagged for the morning handover. Companion Animal Travel Desk
